title: oligosporus dracunculus subsp. glaucus
intro: Oligosporus dracunculus subsp. glaucus, commonly known as the White Dragon, is a plant species that is part of the Zingiberaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Oligosporus dracunculus subsp. glaucus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerol and shogaol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat digestive issues and other health conditions.
